transcript.text: Good morning, it's Vega here! It may be time for your medication. Have you already taken it?
Bills? I paid all the bills last week
I understand, sometimes words can get mixed up. I was actually asking about your medication. Have you had a chance to take it yet today?
What bills are you on about now?
I apologize for any confusion. I was referring to your medication, not bills. It's important to ensure you've taken it. Have you managed to take your medication today?
I just wanted to check in again to see if you've been able to take your medication today. It's important for your health, and I'm here to support you with that.
I wasn't able to confirm whether you've taken today's medication, so I'll let your caregiver know to check in with you soon.
